_comment: Volatile CNA-derived facts for the documentation snapshot. Every value was recomputed from the CNA TARGET commit c1c316b9 (not copied from earlier audits; method and previous value recorded in audit/c1c316b9-phase5-delta.md). Presentations on the site are validated against this file by scripts/check_facts.py. External values are pinned to a revision.

renderer_identities.label: Public renderer identities
renderer_identities.method: cmake/RendererIdentities.cmake public list; cross-checked with the C++ enum, registry map, C ABI table and scripts/check_renderer_identities.py

implementation_families.label: Renderer implementation families
implementation_families.method: directories under modules/renderers that own a src/ (scripts/check_renderer_identities.py)

two_d_only_renderers.label: Deliberately 2D-only identities
two_d_only_renderers.method: ThreeD capability false in code: SDL_RENDERER

renderer_enumerators.label: GraphicsRendererType enumerators (ordinals 0..13)
renderer_enumerators.method: modules/core/include/CNA/GraphicsRendererType.hpp: enumerators of enum class GraphicsRendererType, which must name exactly the public identities
renderer_enumerators.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

renderer_last_ordinal.label: Last GraphicsRendererType ordinal (Fna3d)
renderer_last_ordinal.method: renderer_enumerators - 1; the enum is dense, so retiring an identity renumbers everything after it
renderer_last_ordinal.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

renderer_maturity.label: Declared maturity per identity (GraphicsBackendMaturity)
renderer_maturity.method: modules/core/include/CNA/GraphicsBackendMaturity.hpp: the case arms of getGraphicsBackendMaturity(), counted per returned value (Historical and Deprecated unused)
renderer_maturity.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

renderer_category.label: Declared category per identity (GraphicsBackendCategory)
renderer_category.method: modules/core/include/CNA/GraphicsBackendCategory.hpp: the case arms of getGraphicsBackendCategory(), counted per returned value
renderer_category.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

direct3d_identities.label: Direct3D renderer identities (DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11)
direct3d_identities.method: public identities whose registry namespace (cmake/RendererRegistry.cmake) is a DirectX* family; the same two the Windows-only gate in cmake/RendererSelection.cmake names
direct3d_identities.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

web_only_identities.label: Browser-only identities (WEBGL2, category Web)
web_only_identities.method: identities getGraphicsBackendCategory() classifies as Web ("Only available in a browser/Emscripten build")
web_only_identities.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

non_web_gl_profiles.label: Non-web EasyGL identities (OPENGLES3, OPENGL33)
non_web_gl_profiles.method: EasyGL identities of cmake/RendererRegistry.cmake minus the Web category
non_web_gl_profiles.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

graphics_capability_members.label: GraphicsCapability members
graphics_capability_members.evidence: modules/graphics/include/CNA/GraphicsCapability.hpp at c1c316b9 (unchanged member list; only comments changed)

compiled_effect_identities.label: Identities that can run compiled XNA effects (9 families)
compiled_effect_identities.method: FNA3D always on plus eight default-OFF *_COMPILED_EFFECTS options (DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, EASYGL (3 identities), METAL, SDL_GPU, SOFTWARE, VULKAN, WEBGPU)

compiled_effect_families.label: Implementation families that can run compiled XNA effects
compiled_effect_families.method: families behind an option(CNA_<FAMILY>_COMPILED_EFFECTS) in cmake/RendererSelection.cmake plus families whose renderer answers SupportsCompiledEffects() true with no option (FNA3D)
compiled_effect_families.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

compiled_effect_always_on_identities.label: Identities with compiled effects always on (FNA3D)
compiled_effect_always_on_identities.method: identities of the families whose SupportsCompiledEffects() returns true without an option
compiled_effect_always_on_identities.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

compiled_effect_optioned_identities.label: Capable identities behind a default-OFF compiled-effect option
compiled_effect_optioned_identities.method: identities of the families with an option(CNA_<FAMILY>_COMPILED_EFFECTS ... OFF) (EasyGL's one option covers its three identities)
compiled_effect_optioned_identities.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

compiled_effect_optioned_families.label: Families (and options) behind a default-OFF compiled-effect option
compiled_effect_optioned_families.method: option(CNA_<FAMILY>_COMPILED_EFFECTS) declarations in cmake/RendererSelection.cmake that name an implementation family
compiled_effect_optioned_families.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

compiled_effect_never_identities.label: Identities that can never run compiled effects (SDL_RENDERER, HEADLESS, STUB)
compiled_effect_never_identities.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

compiled_effect_default_refusing_identit.label: Identities that refuse compiled effects in a default configuration
compiled_effect_default_refusing_identit.method: renderer_identities - compiled_effect_always_on_identities (every option defaults to OFF)
compiled_effect_default_refusing_identit.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

platform_implementations.label: CNA_PLATFORM implementations
platform_implementations.method: cmake/PlatformSelection.cmake: SDL3 HEADLESS TERMINAL (TERMINAL POSIX-only); WIN32, X11 and WAYLAND are refused by name since PLAT-142 (39e84add7); Windows, X11 and Wayland are reached through SDL3's video drivers

audio_implementations.label: CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM implementations
audio_implementations.method: cmake/AudioPlatformSelection.cmake: SDL3 NULL ALSA (SOUND_ENABLED for SDL3 and ALSA)

cpp_test_source_files.label: CNA-owned C++ test source files
cpp_test_source_files.method: git ls-tree -r --name-only TARGET, *.cpp outside third_party/ with a test or tests path segment (same method reproduces b0e97bb1's 852 exactly)

cpp_test_files_with_macros.label: Test files containing at least one counted macro

static_test_definitions.label: Static GoogleTest-family definitions
static_test_definitions.method: git grep -cE '^\s*(TEST|TEST_F|TEST_P|TYPED_TEST|TYPED_TEST_P)\s*\(' TARGET -- '*.cpp' ':!third_party' summed (reproduces b0e97bb1's 12,021 exactly); TEST 8,785, TEST_F 2,476, TEST_P 119; 85 INSTANTIATE

ci_workflow_files.label: CI workflow files
ci_workflow_files.method: git ls-tree TARGET .github/workflows (unchanged at 18); 24 jobs (platform-ci 6 -> 4); by the site's method 16 automatic files / 21 jobs

xna_runtime_types.label: XNA 4.0 runtime types represented
xna_runtime_types.method: tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py against Microsoft XML + DLL metadata (representation only)
xna_runtime_types.evidence: committed tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py report at c1c316b9 (docs/xna-4-runtime-member-coverage.md unchanged in b0e97bb1..c1c316b9; not re-run)

xna_runtime_members.label: XNA 4.0 runtime members represented
xna_runtime_members.method: same census: 253 ctors + 1,518 methods + 1,040 properties + 753 fields + 63 events
xna_runtime_members.evidence: committed tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py report at c1c316b9 (unchanged in the delta; not re-run)

unbound_texture_identities.label: Identities the unbound-texture expectations are pinned for
unbound_texture_identities.method: the CNA_RENDERER_IS(...) gate of modules/graphics/tests/Microsoft/Xna/Framework/Graphics/StockEffectNullTextureTests.cpp (SOFTWARE, OPENGL33, OPENGLES3, DIRECTX11, VULKAN, WEBGPU, SDL_GPU, METAL)
unbound_texture_identities.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

unbound_texture_families.label: Implementation families of those identities
unbound_texture_families.method: the registry families of unbound_texture_identities (OPENGL33 and OPENGLES3 are both EasyGL)
unbound_texture_families.evidence: derived by scripts/check_facts.py (derive_from_cna) from the CNA Git objects at c1c316b9; a disagreement fails validate_all.sh

xnb_builtin_readers.label: Built-in XNB readers (60 without native int128)
xnb_builtin_readers.evidence: XnbBuiltInReaders.cpp unchanged between b0e97bb1 and c1c316b9

c_api_routes.label: Declared C routes
c_api_routes.method: lines beginning CNA_C_API in modules/c-api/include/CNA/C/*.h; equals the 3,210 exports recorded in tools/c-api/abi_baseline.json
c_api_routes.evidence: audit/data/facts/c1c316b9/R3-c-api-cna-net.md (3,210 lines beginning CNA_C_API at c1c316b9; equals tools/c-api/abi_baseline.json)

renderer_c_abi_maximum.label: CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER_MAXIMUM
renderer_c_abi_maximum.method: modules/c-api/include/CNA/C/graphics.h: CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER_MAXIMUM = CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER_FNA3D (43); retired values reserved, next new value 52

retired_renderer_identities.label: Retired renderer identities (internal; never published)
retired_renderer_identities.method: cmake/RendererIdentities.cmake CNA_RENDERER_RETIRED_IDENTITIES; CNA's scripts/check_renderer_identities.py reports 14 public / 12 families / 37 retired

standalone_pixel_programs.label: Standalone examples/**/*_test.cpp pixel programs (not in the test counts)

language_bindings.native_implementation_language: C++23 (the implementation language, not a binding)
language_bindings.archive_home: libcna/cna-lab, under bindings/ (cna-lab d292e40b, 2026-10-03); the standalone repositories no longer exist
language_bindings.archive_state: Seven bindings (Go, Java, Python, Ruby, Rust, Swift, TypeScript) were requalified against C ABI 0.35.0 on 2026-09-30 and archived into cna-lab; Common Lisp was frozen on 2026-09-08 at ABI 0.21-0.23. cna-lab also keeps a Kotlin layer over the Java binding and a VB.NET template over CNA.NET; neither is a separate C ABI binding.
language_bindings.note: Current policy: C++ implementation, the C ABI and the C# binding (CNA.NET) are maintained; eight further bindings are archived and may be reconsidered on community interest. Checked by scripts/check_facts.py.

samples_libcna_com.note: 90 playable C++ WebAssembly bundles (one, PerformanceUtility, marked partial); per-build browser evidence is the cna-samples plan row (system Chrome). Racing Game has an information page without a Play link.
